name: NORMIE premarket-flag balance inflation and forced swapback
summary: NORMIE's _transfer flagged any recipient of exactly the team wallet's balance as premarket_user, and credited the token contract the full amount, unbacked, whenever the pair sent tokens to a flagged address. The attacker flagged its helper, looped skim() to inflate the contract balance and forced unbounded swapbacks that dumped NORMIE into the pair, then bought back cheaply.

campaign.selection: transactions not sent by 0xf7f3a556ac21d081f6dba961b6a84e52e37a717d in which the NORMIE/WETH pair 0x24605e0bb933f6ec96e6bbbcea0be8cc880f6e6f emits at least 20 NORMIE Transfer events as sender (the skim loop); each also nets WETH out of the pair

notes: Reset is removeLimitsTx (max-tx 1% to 100% of supply): the anchor moves 11.4M NORMIE between non-exempt addresses, above the original 10M cap, so the raised limit was needed (rule 10).

Loss is the pair's net WETH outflow summed over every skim-loop transaction, priced per block. It includes the forced-swapback ETH the team wallet received (100.05 in the anchor): LPs lost it whoever received it.
The attacker's later nonce+1 transactions with no logs only withdrew proceeds; the 14 skim-loop transactions are the campaign, followed by copycat bots in the bundle.
